title: SM5 Racer TC-2

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Built for aggressive dirt performance, the Alpinestars SM5 Racer TC-2 is crafted for intense dirt riding with ultra-wide goggle eyeport stabilization across punishing tracks and trails. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at 1453g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~99 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. An ultra-breathable, antimicrobial interior liner stabilizes the helmet during aggressive terrain vibration, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Affordable Alpinestars MX helmet with multi-density EPS.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: The Alpinestars SM5 Racer TC-2 is a motocross/dirt bike helmet designed for off-road racing. It features a carbon fiber composite shell with an EPS liner and a removable chin bar (TC-2). The fit is generally aggressive and low-profile, suitable for riders with Intermediate Oval head shapes who prefer a tight, secure fit typical of MX helmets.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Alpinestars SM5 Racer TC-2: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Alpinestars SM5 Racer TC-2: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Alpinestars SM5 Racer TC-2. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

introduction: Positioned in Alpinestars's Dirt / MX lineup, the SM5 Racer TC-2 brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Alpinestars SM5 Racer TC-2 represents Alpinestars's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~99 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Dirt / MX helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Alpinestars SM5 Racer TC-2 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
